name: Animation timeline tags clips and controls playback with onion skinning
description: Verify adding and duplicating animation frames, adjusting frame rate (FPS), toggling onion skinning ghosts, and managing animation loop clips.

planSteps.description: Select the Pen tool and draw a bouncing ball in the center canvas on Frame 1
Click the '+ Add Frame' button in the bottom animation timeline bar
Draw the ball slightly lower on Frame 2
Click the '+ Add Frame' button to create Frame 3
Draw the ball flattened against the bottom ground on Frame 3
Click the Onion Skin toggle button in the timeline bar
Verify onion skinning ghosts render previous frames in tinted alpha behind the active canvas
Click the Play animation button (spacebar or Play button)
Verify the timeline actively cycles through frames 1, 2, and 3 in a continuous loop
Click the Pause button to stop animation playback
